_meta.about: Team fight scenarios (model choices). Teams mirror each other except that Kalista replaces the enemy marksman, so with Kalista swapped for a marksman profile every fight is even: the score measures what Kalista's build adds. Units use the class profiles (calibrated multipliers) or real kits. Supports own fewer items.
_meta.score: Like the duel score: your team's average HP left if it wins (+0.40 = won on 40%), minus the enemy team's average HP left if it loses. Each scenario is averaged over Kalista hitting the frontline first and the backline first.

targets._note: Who each role hits first; 'carry' includes Kalista. Tanks, carries and mages hit what is in front; bruisers are the divers that go for the carries.

carry_note: The 'carry' goal: single-target strength in skirmishes (1v1 duel, 2v2, 3v3) without giving up teamfights (5v5). Ask before changing these weights; they are the user's stated priorities.

engage_delay._note: Seconds before each role first acts: frontline engages, mages poke from range, divers need time to reach the backline.
